full_page.content:
Page 181
Jan. 9 Mrs. Stella Jaksbiak - 34 - mental in Ypsilanti .. ...
Geo. DiHuyvetter - 59 - atheist .... wife Catholic. Daughter as well as wife heart broken .. ....
9th Agnes LaBelle - 37 - Nerveous break-down .... improving of late but .. . .
Mrs. Schultz - about 60 - Neuritis
10 Marie Tireman - 42 - asks prayers for recover of "Boy friend" .... T.B.
10 Jacquelin Cullen - 10 - infantile paral .... cured - went to Kiefer Hospital Thursday August 17th. Had all indications of infantile. Specialist sent her - returned Saturday 2nd day after OK.
Gerald McCloskey - 21 - Sarcoma .... prayed for last week .... fond hopes.
Thomas Foley - 42 - palsey - can't sleep ....
Kenneth Probost - 4 - beautiful child - otherwise bright & happy but unable to talk.
Page 182 Jan 12th Sheldon Heaston - 3 - parents "disciples of Christ Church" - Child seemingly bright but has never spoken except one word "Mama" Enrolled To-day
Chasta Stephens - 21 - orphan since 5 with Aunt, now keeping company with some one quite without religion. (See. Febr. 21) .... Sept. 19 .. Thank God ... to be married to good young man day-after-tomorrow.
Mrs. Ellen Dee - 40 - Nervous
Mrs. Stella Govan - 36 - "dying of cancer" - mother of three - youngest 4 months old - Husband takes first volume -"City of God" ...
14 Rita Sawicki - 17 - goitre - not well
15 John J. 0'Neill - 24 - losing sight has high blood pressure and bad kid.
Mrs. Grace Joseph - 30 - strep-infection .... (child birth)
